plugins.changelogTitle:
# Changelog

Entries in this file are generated by [semantic-release](https://github.com/semantic-release/semantic-release) from Conventional Commit messages — do not edit it by hand; your commit message is the changelog entry. Historic sections at the bottom were maintained by hand in the Keep a Changelog format.

plugins.releaseBodyTemplate:
<%
var limit = 120000;
var notes = nextRelease.notes;
if (notes.length > limit) {
  var footer = '\n---\n\nGitHub caps a release description at 125000 characters, so this list is shortened. Every change is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/floci-io/floci/blob/' + nextRelease.gitTag + '/CHANGELOG.md).\n';
  var budget = limit - footer.length;
  var sections = notes.split(/\n(?=### )/);
  var out = sections.shift().replace(/\s+$/, '') + '\n';
  var rank = function (s) { return /^### .*BREAKING/.test(s) ? 0 : /^### Features/.test(s) ? 1 : /^### Bug Fixes/.test(s) ? 3 : 2; };
  sections.sort(function (a, b) { return rank(a) - rank(b); });
  sections.forEach(function (section) {
    section = section.replace(/\s+$/, '') + '\n';
    if (out.length + section.length + 1 <= budget) {
      out += '\n' + section;
      return;
    }
    var lines = section.split('\n');
    var kept = [];
    var omitted = 0;
    var used = out.length + 1 + 200;
    lines.forEach(function (line) {
      if (omitted === 0 && used + line.length + 1 <= budget) {
        kept.push(line);
        used += line.length + 1;
      } else if (/^\* /.test(line)) {
        omitted++;
      }
    });
    out += '\n' + kept.join('\n').replace(/\s+$/, '') + '\n';
    if (omitted > 0) {
      out += '\n...and ' + omitted + ' more in this section.\n';
    }
  });
  notes = out + footer;
}
%><%= notes %>
